title: Yellowed Garlicky Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: A light and aerated Brazilian dish featuring apple cider vinegar and garlic, perfect for a keto-friendly meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together apple cider vinegar, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the brine by mixing chicken broth with salt in a small bowl.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush the brine onto the skewers.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
